```yaml
name: Copilot SDK CI

on:
  push:
    branches: [main]
  pull_request:
    branches: [main]

jobs:
  build:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    env:
      # Pass the GitHub token used by the copilot SDK tests
      COPILOT_GITHUB_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.COPILOT_GITHUB_TOKEN }}
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Extract Copilot version
        id: copilot_version
        run: |
          VERSION=$(grep -oP 'DefaultCopilotVersion = \"\K[^\"]+' pkg/constants/constants.go)
          echo "COPILOT_VERSION=$VERSION" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT
        shell: bash

      - name: Set up Node (pnpm)
        uses: kubb-labs/config/.github/setup@main
        with:
          node-version: 24
          cache: pnpm
          force-install: true

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: pnpm install

      - name: Build TypeScript client
        run: pnpm run build

      - name: Run tests
        run: pnpm run test
        env:
          COPILOT_VERSION: ${{ steps.copilot_version.outputs.COPILOT_VERSION }}

      - name: Publish test results
        uses: EnricoMi/publish-unit-test-result-action@v2
        with:
          github_token: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
          files: '**/test-results.xml'

      - name: Upload coverage to Codecov
        uses: getsentry/codecov-action@fda17cfc37e16a0cc23f61685813390bfee7daf3
        with:
          token: ${{ secrets.CODECOV_TOKEN }}
          files: coverage/coverage-final.json
          directory: coverage
          coverage-format: lcov
          fail-ci-if-error: true

      - name: Publish to Testspace
        uses: testspace-com/setup-testspace@v1
        with:
          domain: ${{ secrets.TESTSPACE_DOMAIN }}
          token: ${{ secrets.TESTSPACE_TOKEN }}
          config-args: '--project=repo'
```
